description: This file contains a Backbone.js application implementation in TypeScript. It defines models, collections, views, and routing for a Todo app, including business logic, user interface handling, and application setup. It also includes licensing and licensing information comments.

classes.name: Todo
classes.description: A Backbone Model representing a Todo item, with attributes 'title' and 'completed', methods for toggling completion status, initialization, and clearing the Todo.

classes.name: TodoList
classes.description: A Backbone Collection managing multiple Todo models, with methods for filtering completed/remaining todos, generating the next order number, and setting a comparator for sorting.

classes.name: TodoView
classes.description: A Backbone View responsible for rendering an individual Todo item, handling user interactions such as toggle, edit, update, and delete.

classes.name: TodoRouter
classes.description: A Backbone Router managing URL route filters for the Todo list (filtering by 'all', 'completed', or 'active').

classes.name: AppView
classes.description: The main Backbone View coordinating the overall Todo application. Handles rendering, user input, collection updates, and app initialization.

methods.name: defaults
methods.description: Returns default attributes for a Todo model ('title' and 'completed').

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Todo model, ensuring 'title' is set.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Inverts the 'completed' status of the Todo and saves it.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes the Todo model.

methods.name: completed
methods.description: Returns an array of Todo models marked as completed.

methods.name: remaining
methods.description: Returns an array of Todo models that are not completed.

methods.name: nextOrder
methods.description: Calculates the next order number for new Todo items.

methods.name: comparator
methods.description: Defines the sorting order for Todos based on the 'order' attribute.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the TodoView based on its underlying model.

methods.name: toggleDone
methods.description: Toggles the Todo's completion status.

methods.name: toggleVisible
methods.description: Toggles visibility of the Todo item based on current filter.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Switches the Todo item into editing mode.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Saves or removes the Todo based on input value, exiting editing mode.

methods.name: updateOnEnter
methods.description: Completes editing when the Enter key is pressed.

methods.name: revertOnEscape
methods.description: Reverts editing when the Escape key is pressed.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes the Todo model.

methods.name: setFilter
methods.description: Sets the current filter criteria for Todo display.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates the application UI based on the current Todo collection state.

methods.name: addOne
methods.description: Adds a single Todo item to the DOM.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds all Todo items to the DOM.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Changes the filter setting for which Todos are visible.

methods.name: filterOne
methods.description: Applies the filter visibility to a single Todo.

methods.name: filterAll
methods.description: Applies current filter to all Todos.

methods.name: newAttributes
methods.description: Creates a new set of attributes for a Todo model from user input.

methods.name: createOnEnter
methods.description: Creates a new Todo when Enter is pressed.

methods.name: clearCompleted
methods.description: Removes all completed Todos.

methods.name: toggleAllComplete
methods.description: Toggles all Todos to completed or active.

methods.name: constructor (attr? , opts? ); constructor
methods.description: unavailable
